title: AIアシスタントを使ってみる
lines: Have you tried using an AI assistant for your emails?
Yeah, I use it every morning. It writes a first draft, and then I fix it.
Does it save you much time?
Maybe twenty minutes a day. But I always check the names and dates myself.
Sometimes. It once sent a meeting invite for the wrong week.

questions.q: B はAIアシスタントをどう使っている？
choices: メールの下書きを作らせて自分で直す
メールを全部自動で送らせる
会議の議事録を作らせる
questions.explain: It writes a first draft, and then I fix it.

questions.q: B が自分で確認するのは？
questions.explain: I always check the names and dates myself.

questions.q: 以前起きた失敗は？
choices: 違う週の会議招待を送った
questions.explain: sent a meeting invite for the wrong week

title: ポッドキャスト：AIと学び方
lines: Welcome back to the show. Today I want to talk about how AI is changing the way people learn new skills.
A few years ago, if you wanted to learn to code, you'd watch long videos and hope they covered your exact problem.
Now you can paste your error message into a chatbot and get an explanation in seconds.
That's great for getting unstuck, but there's a catch. If you never struggle, you might not remember the solution next time.
So my advice is simple: try for ten minutes on your own before you ask the AI.

questions.q: このポッドキャストの話題は？
choices: プログラミング言語の比較
チャットボットの作り方
questions.explain: how AI is changing the way people learn new skills

questions.explain: If you never struggle, you might not remember the solution next time.

questions.q: 話し手のアドバイスは？
choices: AIに聞く前に10分は自分で試す
questions.explain: try for ten minutes on your own before you ask the AI

title: AI機能のリリース会議
lines: So the question is whether the summary feature is ready to ship next Tuesday.
Technically, yes. Accuracy on our test set is around ninety-two percent.
My concern is the other eight percent. When it's wrong, it sounds just as confident as when it's right.
Could we show a warning when the source document is very long? That's where most errors happen.
That's doable by Tuesday. A proper confidence score would take another month, though.
OK, let's ship with the warning and put the confidence score on the roadmap.

choices: 間違えたときも自信ありげに見える
テストデータが少ない
questions.explain: When it's wrong, it sounds just as confident as when it's right.

questions.q: 誤りが多いのはどんなとき？
choices: 元の文書が非常に長いとき

questions.q: 会議の結論は？
choices: 警告表示付きで火曜にリリースし、信頼度スコアは今後の計画に入れる
信頼度スコアを火曜までに完成させる
questions.explain: let's ship with the warning and put the confidence score on the roadmap

title: 講義：AI規制のジレンマ
lines: Regulating a technology that changes every few months poses a genuine dilemma for lawmakers.
Rules written too early tend to target the wrong risks, while rules written too late arrive after the harmful practices have already become standard.

One proposed compromise is to regulate outcomes rather than methods: instead of banning particular techniques, you hold companies responsible for measurable harms, whatever the underlying model happens to be.
Critics point out, however, that some harms, such as gradual erosion of trust, are notoriously hard to measure.

choices: 変化の速い技術をどう規制するか
questions.explain: Regulating a technology that changes every few months poses a genuine dilemma

questions.explain: regulate outcomes rather than methods

questions.q: 批判者の指摘は？
choices: 信頼の低下のように測りにくい害がある
questions.explain: some harms, such as gradual erosion of trust, are notoriously hard to measure

title: 取引先との電話
lines: Hi Sarah, it's Ken from Brightline. Thanks for sending the contract.
No problem. Did you have any questions about it?
Just one. Section four says payment is due in thirty days. Our finance team usually works with sixty.
I see. I can't change that myself, but I'll ask my manager and get back to you by Thursday.
That'd be great. Everything else looks fine to us.

questions.explain: payment is due in thirty days. Our finance team usually works with sixty.

questions.q: Sarah はどうする？
choices: 上司に確認して木曜までに返事する
経理部に直接電話する
questions.explain: I'll ask my manager and get back to you by Thursday

title: 予算の見直し
lines: We're about fifteen percent over budget on the marketing campaign. Where did most of it go?
Mostly the video production. The agency charged extra for the second round of edits.
Was the second round really necessary?
Honestly, part of it was our fault. We changed the main message after filming had already started.
Then let's agree on the message before we brief any agency next time, and cap the number of revisions in the contract.

choices: 動画制作の追加修正費
questions.explain: Mostly the video production. The agency charged extra for the second round of edits.

questions.q: B が認めたことは？
choices: 撮影開始後にメッセージを変えた自社の責任
questions.explain: part of it was our fault. We changed the main message after filming had already started.

questions.q: 次回の対策は？
choices: 依頼前にメッセージを決め、修正回数を契約で制限する
questions.explain: agree on the message before we brief any agency … cap the number of revisions

title: 決算説明会
lines: Revenue for the quarter came in slightly below our guidance, primarily due to delayed orders from two large enterprise customers.
We want to emphasize that neither order was cancelled; both have since been signed and will be recognized next quarter.
Excluding those deals, growth in our subscription business actually accelerated, which we view as the more important long-term indicator.

title: 自然な会話：週末の予定
lines: So, um, are you doing anything this weekend?
Not really. Well, actually, I was thinking of going hiking, if the weather's OK.
Oh, nice. Where? The hills near the lake?
Yeah, exactly. Do you, uh, want to come? We could leave around eight.
Eight's a bit early for me. How about nine?
Sure, nine works. I'll text you on Saturday night.

title: 自然な会話：久しぶりの再会
lines: Hey! I haven't seen you in ages. How's the new job going?
Oh, it's good. I mean, it was kind of crazy at first, you know, so many new people.
I bet. Are you still commuting by train?
No, actually, they let me work from home three days a week now, so I only go in on Mondays and Thursdays.
That sounds perfect. You must save a ton of time.
I do, yeah. Although, honestly, I kind of miss chatting with people at the office.
